page_about_title: Building the financial layer for the open internet.
page_about_sub: promrkts is a global crypto platform where anyone, anywhere can trade, and move value across borders — as easily as sending a message.
page_about_story_p1: We started promrkts because moving money globally shouldn't take three days, five intermediaries, and a pile of paperwork. Neither should issuing a token, running a treasury, or paying a team spread across ten time zones.
page_about_story_p2: We combine the regulatory rigor of a bank with the openness of crypto rails — regulated custody, on-chain proof-of-reserves, verified P2P, and a social wallet anyone can pick up in minutes.
page_about_v1_d: Published reserves, open fee schedules, and a fully auditable on-chain treasury.
page_about_v2_d: 14+ fiat and crypto currencies, 9+ chains, dozens of languages, one unified account.
page_about_v3_d: Multi-sig custody, hardware-key support, mandatory 2FA and 98% cold-storage.
page_about_v4_d: Your keys, your coins. Non-custodial mode available for every balance.
page_terms_intro: These Terms of Service govern your access to and use of the promrkts platform. By creating an account, you agree to these terms.
page_terms_s1_d: By registering, accessing, or using promrkts, you agree to be bound by these Terms and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, do not use the service.
page_terms_s2_d: You must be at least 18 years old and legally able to enter into binding contracts. promrkts may be unavailable in certain jurisdictions due to local regulations.
page_terms_s3_d: You are responsible for safeguarding your login credentials, 2FA devices, and private keys. promrkts is not liable for losses resulting from compromised credentials.
page_terms_s4_d: Identity verification is mandatory for most features. We reserve the right to suspend accounts that fail due-diligence, request additional documents, or exhibit suspicious activity.
page_terms_s5_d: Applicable trading, withdrawal, and network fees are displayed on the /fees page and in-app prior to every transaction. Fees may change with notice.
page_terms_s6_d: No money laundering, terrorist financing, sanctions evasion, market manipulation, or unlawful use of the platform. Violations will lead to immediate termination and reporting to authorities.
page_terms_s7_d: Crypto-assets are volatile. Values can go to zero. You trade at your own risk. Past performance does not guarantee future results.
page_terms_s8_d: To the fullest extent permitted by law, promrkts is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages.
page_terms_s9_d: These Terms are governed by the laws applicable to our place of incorporation, with reference to international commercial dispute resolution where applicable.
page_terms_s10_d: Questions? Reach our legal team at legal@promrkts.com.
page_privacy_intro: Your privacy matters. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and the rights you have over it.
page_privacy_s1_d: Account data (name, email, phone), KYC documents (government ID, proof of address), transaction metadata, device and network info, and optional profile details.
page_privacy_s2_d: To verify your identity, comply with AML regulations, prevent fraud, process transactions, improve our service, and send you account-related communications.
page_privacy_s3_d: Regulators when legally required, KYC providers under strict DPAs, payment partners for transaction processing, and cloud hosting (AWS eu-central-1) encrypted at rest.
page_privacy_s4_d: Access your data, request correction, request deletion (subject to regulatory retention), and portability. Contact privacy@promrkts.com.
page_privacy_s5_d: Account and KYC data retained for 7 years after closure to meet regulatory requirements. Marketing preferences honored immediately.
page_privacy_s6_d: We use essential cookies for authentication and analytics cookies to improve the product. You may opt out of non-essential cookies at any time.
page_privacy_s7_d: Data encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3). 24/7 SOC monitoring. Bug bounty program. Regular external audits.
page_fees_sub: No hidden charges. No surprise spreads. Every fee promrkts takes is published here.

page_help_sub: Search our help center or browse the most common topics below.
page_help_cat_getting_d: Create an account, verify your identity, add funds.
page_help_faq1_a: Most verifications are automated and complete within 15 minutes. Manual reviews take up to 24 hours.
page_help_faq2_q: Can I reverse a P2P trade?
page_help_faq2_a: Escrow locks funds until both parties confirm. If your counterparty disputes, our team mediates within 2 hours.
page_help_faq3_q: What happens if I lose my 2FA device?
page_help_faq3_a: Use your backup recovery code at login. If unavailable, contact support — identity verification via KYC is required to restore access.
page_help_faq4_a: Fiat balances are held in segregated accounts at Tier-1 banking partners. Crypto balances are 98% cold-stored and fully reserved, with monthly proof-of-reserves attestations.
page_help_faq5_q: How do I track my portfolio?
page_help_faq5_a: Open the Portfolio tab to see all your balances, asset allocation, and transaction history across every supported chain.
page_help_faq6_q: What payment methods are supported for deposits?
page_help_faq6_a: Bank transfers, mobile payments, and card deposits are supported. Available methods vary by region.
page_help_faq7_a: Bitcoin, Ethereum, BNB Chain, Solana, Polygon, Tron, Avalanche, Arbitrum and Optimism — with more added regularly. One account, every network.
page_help_faq8_a: promrkts is available in 120+ countries. Some features (cards,  specific local payment rails) vary by region and are shown as you onboard.
page_help_contact_d: Our support team responds in under 4 hours, 7 days a week.
